title: Reference data for Figure 3: ITU-T bands, documented single-amplifier windows, and the anchors of the Pr3+ and Tm3+ line shapes
model: none (reference data; no amplifier model uses these entries). fig03_spectroscopy.py draws Figure 3 from them.
notes: Windows are wavelength ranges [lo, hi] in nm. 'P25' = B.J. Puttnam et al., High data-rate OESCLU-band transmission, J. Lightwave Technol. 43(23), 10371-10379 (2025), doi:10.1109/JLT.2025.3543448 (accepted manuscript, Aston eprint 47272; journal version of manuscript ref. [7]; NEW reference). Entries marked 'derived' are recomputed by fig03_spectroscopy.py and the script stops if they disagree (V2). Pr3+ and Tm3+ line widths are illustrative assumptions, not data.

tm_peak_ratio.applies_to: emission-to-absorption peak ratio used for the Tm3+ panel

T_spectro.applies_to: temperature of the McCumber transform used to draw the Tm3+ emission line shape

tm_width_s.derivation: single Gaussian absorption band in photon energy E (standard deviation s); its McCumber transform is a Gaussian of equal s centered at E_a - s^2/(k_B T), so s^2 = k_B T (E_a - E_e) with E = 1e7/lambda
tm_width_s.applies_to: width parameter of the Tm3+ line shapes (FWHM = 2.3548 s)

verification.note: property of the parameterization, not a measured width

tm_eps.derivation: eps = (E_a + E_e)/2 + k_B T ln(tm_peak_ratio), from the peak-ratio condition of the Gaussian McCumber pair
tm_eps.applies_to: excitation energy of the Tm3+ line-shape pair (crossing wavelength about 1755 nm)

verification.note: property of the parameterization, not a measured excitation energy
